## Alt Almanac 1.0

First release.

- One window with all your characters: name in class colour, level, gold, zone and rested bonus.
- Each character is updated whenever you play it: on login, when your gold, level, zone or rested bonus changes, and on logout.
- The rested bonus of characters you are not playing keeps growing in the list, faster for those who logged out in an inn or a city. Resting characters are shown in blue.
- Shows when you last played each character, and the total gold of all of them.
- Sorted by level, then by name. Up to 15 rows, the last one counts any further characters.
- Open it with `/aa` or `/altalmanac`. `/aa forget Name-Realm` removes a character from the list. Drag the window anywhere, its position is remembered.

## Alt Almanac 1.1

- New **Played** column: the total time played of every character, like `/played`, shown as minutes, hours or days.
- The total line now also adds up the played time of all your characters.
- The time is read quietly a few seconds after login, without the usual `/played` lines in your chat. Your own `/played` still prints as always.
- The character you are playing keeps counting while the window is open.
- Characters you have not logged in with since this update show a dash and are not in the total yet. Log in with each of them once.
- The window is a little wider so the new column fits. All your saved characters from 1.0 are kept.

## Alt Almanac 1.2

- **Sort by any column**: click a heading (character, level, gold, zone, rested, played or last seen) to sort the list by it, click it again to reverse the order. The column you sort by is shown in white with a small arrow.
- Characters whose value is not known yet always stay at the bottom, whichever way you sort.
- New **filters** at the bottom of the window: tick "This realm only" to hide characters of other realms, and type a level into "Hide below level" to hide your low alts. The character you are playing is always shown.
- The total line adds up the gold and played time of the characters shown, and a short note tells how many the filter hides.
- `/aa realm this` and `/aa realm all`, `/aa level 70` and `/aa level off` set the filters from the chat.
- Your sort order and filters are saved. All your characters and settings from 1.0 and 1.1 are kept, and the list starts in the familiar order: highest level first.
- The window is a little taller so the filters fit.

## Alt Almanac 1.3

- Alt Almanac now speaks **German**: the window, the filters, the tooltip and every chat line. On clients in other languages it stays in English.
- The column headings Character, Level, Zone, Rested and Played and the Total line come from the game itself now, so they read exactly like in your client's language. In English they stay the same words.
- The Level column is a little wider, so its heading always fits next to the sort arrow. The Character column gave up the space.
- The commands stay the same in every language, for example `/aa realm this` or `/aa level off`.
- All your characters, your sort order and your filters from 1.2 are kept.
